title: Introduce Work Order Schema v3
risks: Incorrect sequencing could make v3 Work Orders unreadable by introspection or constitutional audit
Retrospective history support could be abused if not constrained by durable evidence
Work Order schema v2 cannot represent compatibility per affected contract
reversal: Before any implementation exists, create a dedicated reversal branch from published main and run git revert on the commit that registered this proposal. Confirm that the revert removes WORK-011 and restores the prior work-order index, then run the complete suite, compileall, git diff --check, and the constitutional audit before publishing the reviewed reversal. Do not modify WORK-009 or runtime, and do not rewrite Git history.
